comment: What OpenStar reads from download-progress.txt, yt-dlp's output with --newline and --progress-template 'download:%(progress._percent_str)s|%(progress._speed_str)s|%(progress._eta_str)s'. One entry per progress line, in order; every other line is not progress. Speeds in bytes per second (binary units, rounded down), ETAs in seconds, null where yt-dlp does not know.
